s4a_verdict.root_cause_diagnosed: TWO-PART ROOT CAUSE for S.4a blockage:
s4a_verdict.root_cause_1_coverage_tick_limit: coverage-tick was fetching traces with limit=200. With ~5 traces/min from boredom, limit=200 covered only ~40min of history. The client-side time filter (ts >= since) DOES work, but the 2h/3h/4h windows all got the same 200 most recent traces — their filters were broad enough to accept all 200, giving identical rl counts. Only the 1h window filtered enough to show fewer traces (rl=9 vs 11). The substrate diagnosed this and fixed it (b39db49f bumps dev-vessel to 84638bb limit=2000). DEPLOYED: confirmed in container at /vessels/development-vessel/src/resolvers/coverage-tick.ts line 45.
s4a_verdict.root_cause_2_boredom_template_monocultur: Boredom's abstract goal phrasing ('measure the substrate topology and report coverage progress') was being matched by compose_goal's LLM to high-alpha templates (validator-dispatch α=3759, slot-binding α=534). These 3 templates produce only 3 unique shapes, causing rl to plateau. The substrate diagnosed this (commit 71960aff message explicitly cites 'validator-dispatch a=3887, slot-binding a=552'). FIX: goals now name templates explicitly ('run the coverage-tick activity', 'run the harness-check-scenario activity', 'run the add-resolver-to-vessel activity'). DEPLOYED: confirmed in boredom-vessel logs at 00:03Z.
